objs.name: document
objs.description: Controlled policy or guideline document managed from creation through release, distribution, revision, archiving and reactivation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default name composed of document type abbreviation, consecutive number and title.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status of the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Maintained property for linking the document to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Maintained property for linking the document to IT applications.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Maintained property for areas of validity.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used for templates, validity periods and archive duration.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in document names.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which a validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period before archived documents are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable for new document objects of a document type.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as creator, author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, applicant, initiator or acknowledgement recipient.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION, such as document reader, author, reviewer, approver or translator.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign authorizations, roles, reader access, distribution and archive access.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or write right assigned to users or user groups for a document and dependent objects.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document containing user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment that is not subject to the main document release cycle and can be released, published or deleted directly.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment released with the main document and subject to versioning and archiving.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document and managed without initially affecting the document content or version history.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity is close to expiry.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request for declaring a released document out of force and archiving it.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants for release, validity extension, override, reactivation or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete release workflow tasks and documented per released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: E-mail sent to users about workflow tasks, releases, validity extension, change proposals or acknowledgements.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be visible.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process to which documents can be linked by database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit to which documents can be linked by database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk to which documents can be linked by database integration.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents can be linked by database integration.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type or template.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the document content with the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the edited document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_release_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser or translation participant in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via property switches.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an attachment with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process after document creation, content maintenance and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check the document and complete their tasks.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releasers approve the document for release.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so addressed readers can see it.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new editing version when a released document is revised.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request and update the valid until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document and its attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, create a new version, restore authorizations and reactivate archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons to distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request recipients by e-mail to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document without a signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Automatically or manually link documents with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents or master data.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Send an e-mail notification to involved users.
